scope: Read-only evidence graph, no executable nodes; candidate edges are not verified dependencies. R06 replaces overlapping R05 BSD. Historical endpoint registry is not merged as current facts.

nodes.label: kernel
nodes.description: Process-local memory, scheduling, synchronization, handles, timing, IPC; protected process management separately reviewed
nodes.constraints: fork/exec, signals, shared libraries, virtual memory semantics and quotas not POSIX-equivalent

nodes.label: ipc
nodes.description: Client/server IPC, named ports, sessions, CMIF/TIPC, service discovery
nodes.constraints: NPDM service ACL; server hosting not assumed

nodes.label: filesystem
nodes.description: SD and permitted save/storage, file/directory APIs, RomFS and devoptab
nodes.constraints: mount and per-title permissions; no unrestricted NAND or other users' saves

nodes.label: display
nodes.description: Display layers, buffer queues, framebuffer, NVIDIA graphics, synchronization fences
nodes.constraints: GPU API/driver compatibility, multiple surfaces, modes and applet ownership; Vulkan/OpenGL are separate ports

nodes.label: audio
nodes.description: Playback, recording, render graph and device discovery, hardware Opus decoder
nodes.constraints: capture consent, device/firmware capabilities; no blanket access

nodes.label: input
nodes.description: Controller, keyboard/mouse where supported, touch, motion, IR, vibration, attached HID devices
nodes.constraints: model/peripheral availability; privileged injection disabled

nodes.label: network
nodes.description: BSD sockets, DNS, interface status, TLS, local communication
nodes.constraints: official Nintendo network integration denied; routes/endpoints require own policy; raw sockets, TUN, netlink, WireGuard support not assumed

nodes.label: usb
nodes.description: Host and device interfaces and data transfer
nodes.constraints: host/device role, class protocols, exclusive access; no installation of protected content

nodes.label: bluetooth
nodes.description: Bluetooth and BLE via permissioned services
nodes.constraints: profile coverage, access and concurrency require verification

nodes.label: power
nodes.description: Battery, power, sleep/idle, temperatures, backlight, dock and performance control
nodes.constraints: read-only initially; hardware writes require separate safe review

nodes.label: bus
nodes.description: Hardware bus interfaces for board components
nodes.constraints: privileged/hardware-dependent; no arbitrary hardware access

nodes.label: lifecycle
nodes.description: Applet and application lifecycle, loader, process metadata, dynamic code modules
nodes.constraints: registered-title launch and applet mode constraints; protected process and package operations denied

nodes.label: settings
nodes.description: Locale, language, fonts, permitted settings and parental controls
nodes.constraints: no bypass of parental controls; system writes individually reviewed

nodes.label: clock
nodes.description: Wall and steady clocks, time zones
nodes.constraints: clock epoch and permission semantics must be tested

nodes.label: crypto
nodes.description: Randomness, ARM crypto helpers and protected system crypto
nodes.constraints: no protected Nintendo keys or identity manipulation

nodes.label: capture
nodes.description: Screenshots, album, media capture, JPEG and game recording
nodes.constraints: application capture rights and consent; no protected content capture

nodes.label: local_data
nodes.description: Local play records, alarms, Mii/avatar metadata where supported
nodes.constraints: private data minimization; no online sync

nodes.label: diagnostics
nodes.description: Local error context, logging and diagnostics
nodes.constraints: local-only, own app context; no tampering with system telemetry

nodes.label: accounts
nodes.description: Nintendo account, friends and news families
nodes.constraints: Nintendo-linked operations disabled

nodes.label: official
nodes.description: Network installation and content management
nodes.constraints: Nintendo service calls, licenses and protected content mutation disabled
